claims.text: The PMO states that Samuela 'Akilisi Pohiva was declared Tonga's new Prime Minister on 29 December 2014 by the Interim Speaker, Lord Tupou, winning 15-11 against former Deputy Prime Minister Samiu Vaipulu. It adds that 'former Prime Minister Lord Tu'ivakano was elected as new Speaker' and that a new Government was anticipated by the New Year.
claims.uncertainty: Corroborates the Assembly selection. 'Former Prime Minister' describes Tu'ivakano on 29 December and is not used as an end date. The ordinals '16th Prime Minister' and 'second Prime Minister' after 2010 are not imported.
